exposure: Offspring of mothers without HBV or HCV
Offspring of mothers with HBV or HCV
Maternal HBV or HCV carrier status
cohort: 242,342 singleton deliveries between 1991-2014 at a single tertiary medical center
finding: Maternal HBV or HCV carrier status during pregnancy was an independent risk factor for long-term respiratory morbidity in offspring, increasing susceptibility to respiratory-related hospitalization until 18 years of age.
